Great Admiral Lezos and his armada were sailing to conquer an important trading port belonging to a rival empire. Hoping to arrive early and catch the enemy off guard, the admiral led his ships through a gigantic, iceberg-strewn whiteout. But they never truly came back.[br/][br/]When Lezos reappeared, he and his fleet had changed. They rode Hoarfrost Mantas, and dark ice whispered to them, compelling them to freeze the seas and, eventually, the entire world.

After ages spent amassing riches, the avid master trader has invested his wealth and ambition in establishing a legacy brighter than gold.[br/][br/]Convinced that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SilverSeasLoreConcept]the legendary Silver Seas[/hyperlink] are not a place to search, but a place to build, Marinus has founded the Silver Seas Company. The mercantile empire is celebrating marine festivals and opening countless trade routes to enrich itself and its allies. Conquering with coin rather than steel.

The powerful rulers pillaged and looted the riches of their waters, driving the Aqualon tribe to the brink of extinction.
